steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Survival of the fittest, culling of the unfit... since when has Rhine become one of the 'unfit'?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Oh... Mr. Jagger! What are you doing here?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: That's my line. What are you doing here, when you should have already cancelled Lucky Cystybeast's registration?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I'm not doing anything illegal! We solved our technical issues before we filed the cancellation. What a stroke of luck...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: You solved it? Why didn't anyone contact Engineering?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Maybe word didn't have time to get around because of how sudden it was...

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: A-Anyway, Mr. Tannen announced that all technical inspections by Rhine Lab are suspended.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I don't need to report to you anymore.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: How could they have solved it all of a sudden, when three days didn't do it?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: The Lucky Cystybeast's luck?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Quick, take the readings before their people come back.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: All the data is good. Too good, in fact. It's almost as if they were specifically calibrated to the benchmarks.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Wait... these aren't Propeller Paradise standard-issue screws, are they?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: They're completely soldered. Won't budge... the whole core energy module is sealed shut.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: But no power unit on Propeller Paradise sounds like this. No legal power unit, anyway.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Where did they get this weird non-compliant stuff from? I thought all procurement on Propeller Paradise goes through—

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Ah... I get it now. Silly me, for thinking that survival of the fittest was really the rule on Propeller Paradise.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Still helping that bastard put together the report for the accident at Rhine?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Forget it. Director Lunorey would just dismiss me for not having evidence.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Who else can help...?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: My ride will be there in five minutes. I'll bring you a Propeller Paradise mascot plushie if I find one.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm not a kid.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: See you later, then?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You've been playing catch with your 'branches' in the corridor ever since you stepped out of Saria's office.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You're stalling. I can tell.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: There really ought to be a law about invading an individual's privacy with a water clone.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Not likely to happen, unless there's another Water Elf in Columbia.
The 'branches' on Nasti's belt suddenly grow, pointing in the direction of the Water Elf, and twist open a tool attachment.
As though rehearsed a thousand times, Muelsyse takes a step to the right, dodging the bionic branch robot's trick.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You know I'm stuck in Kjerag and can't come in person.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Maintaining a water clone at long distance is a draining task. Are you so worried that I might flub up Kristen's legacy?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's you that I'm worried about, not some derivative of Galleria Stellaria.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It takes time for a seed to grow into a sapling, and all the more so when you hope it will become a towering tree.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Relax. Not even Ferdinand would complain about the results you're pulling.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: That's because I blocked his email.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ahem...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You helped make Kristen's dreams come true by digging away under the Trimounts suburbs. Now it's your turn.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Have you ever thought about...?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I'm not going back to the Convallis.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The serene tranquility of the Convallis does not belong to a flawed Banshee, nor can it inspire her.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: It's time to go.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Just a sec. Here.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: A potted plant?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ecological dug it out of the desert. It's resistant to heat and cold, and just as stubborn as you... call it a goodbye prezzie.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: No need for vivariums, just remember to water it. It'll keep a watchful eye on you... maybe even help you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: In return, take care of the vivarium and yourself, and—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Get me a Propeller Paradise mascot plushie, if they really exist!

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: The withered branches on the first-floor planters have been cleaned up. This potted plant is the only one from the exhibit that survived.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I'll take it.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: What about the underground 'plants'?

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: Transmitted data are as expected, but monitoring coverage is limited. We haven't had time to send someone to check on site.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I'll go. Thanks.

steps.name: Underground Researcher
steps.text: Director Lunorey.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Anyone from outside here?

steps.name: Underground Researcher
steps.text: No, ma'am. We've continued to simulate experimental conditions here.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Mm. Just in case...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: (In Sarkaz) Reveal.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: No sign of entry... was it really an accident?

steps.name: Underground Researcher
steps.text: We've compiled the report on the dead plants. Do you want to review it now?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Alright, let's go.

steps.name: Robotic Voice
steps.text: Nasti Lunorey, Director of Engineering. Credentials confirmed. Welcome.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police A
steps.text: Where the heck did those two go?

steps.name: Tester
steps.text: Did something happen, sir?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police A
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police B
steps.text: No need to be alarmed. We're just simulating missions on the Shadow-Moon. Mr. Tannen's orders.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police B
steps.text: Columbia keeps our people safe, wherever they are.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police B
steps.text: (Split up. Keep a low profile.)

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police A
steps.text: (Roger.)

steps.name: Tester
steps.text: So it was a drill... it's just like a Wrankwood blockbuster! What was it called...? Battlefield Shadow-Moon, I think?

spans.text: So it was a drill... it's just like a Wrankwood blockbuster! What was it called...?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: See? Those guards are Kazimierzian space-knights. Don't give us away!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Skip the comedy, impostor. Where do you go next?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Not many places to hide on the Flying Donut station, while the ring corridor in the back is perfect for an ambush...

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Then what do we do? I signed your tour contract, you gotta get me out of here!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Settle down, Real Oakley. You're on Propeller Paradise. Forget what you think you know about Terra Firma.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: That's a Volvort Kochinski jump-board you're testing, right? Can we borrow it?

steps.name: Tester
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police A
steps.text: Huh? What's that sound?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police B
steps.text: Look up!

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police A
steps.text: How the frick did they get on top of a floating pod?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Oh, I forgot. People look up on Propeller Paradise.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: What do we do?!

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police A
steps.text: Shoot them down!

steps.name: Tester
steps.text: Oh! Is that simulating the air cannon the villain fires in the climactic scene?

steps.name: Tester
steps.text: Wait, I think I smell Originium powder...

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police A
steps.text: Fire!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Trash, all of them! It took so much work just to put Rhine down, but now we have a rogue tour guide on the loose...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I would have gone after that Feline myself, if I didn't have business to do.

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: Would you like me to eliminate those ignorant Terrans, Sky Conqueror? Show them true power from beyond Terra?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: No need, Five-Four. She's a tour guide, not a special agent.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: First, report on Gustave.

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: He and his retinue are floating around Cloud and the VIP area. They have passed through the ring corridor, but no one has found the hidden door yet.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Hah. When I first joined ATAO seven years ago, Gustave would notice if I swiped a liquid Originium lighter from a stowaway.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I thought he didn't like me because he used to be a soldier, hated crooks and wanted everything to be done the right way. Only later did I find out it was because I left too many loose ends.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I learned everything from him, his way of doing things, his way of talking, even how I dress. As for the result—

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: This pod holds treasures from across Terra.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: It's much bigger than ATAO's dirty lockers.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Gustave on one side, Nasti on the other. So what?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I'm not the clueless kid from seven years ago. They'll never find out what I did, unless I hand-deliver the evidence.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Once the exhibition opens, and thousands of exhibits fly into the sky, all the 'secrets' and 'illicit transactions' won't matter anymore.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Every one will know that it was Gordon Tannen who lit the fire under Propeller Paradise. Not Rhine, not D.C.

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: Warning! Terran approaching!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: What's that sound?
Don't blow it up... might be somebody... below...
Don't try to... talk... way out of...!
Gordon Tannen looks up in the smoke and dust as he forces his teary eyes open, trying to see just what is going on.
A familiar figure descends amidst the rubble and dust, her legs flailing wildly. He just ordered her arrest several hours ago.
They are only about ninety centimeters apart, both their brains working feverishly to process the situation.
Time itself feels frozen, as Gordon and Ferne stand off against one another, scrambling to take in each other's expressions.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: (They really blew it up! Where the hell am I, anyway? This place isn't on my map! There was a hidden door in the ring corridor?)

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: (And why am I staring at Tannen right now? Was this a trap? But why is there such a look of surprise and shock on his face?)

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: (Are these exhibits on the walls?)

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: (Wait a second... I've definitely seen these Arts units at the street stalls when I got dragged into the black market by the Sarkaz. And that hat over there—isn't that standard issue for the Zhayedan in Sargonian tombs...?)

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: (Shoot, is it too late to pretend I never saw any of this?)

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: (Oh no, please don't hit the high-explosive Originite grenade, or this entire pod goes up in smoke!)

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: (Dammit, it's been one thing after another since this fake guide came to Propeller Paradise!)

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: (Is she Rhine's enemy, or Nasti's spy? She ruined my plans once at the Vivarium, and now she's doing it again!)

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: (What's she looking at? The active Originium storm guide beacon, or the Zhayedan's witchcraft helmet? Shit, she recognizes these!)

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: (What's she gonna do with the dirt on me? Is she gonna sell it to someone? If Nasti or Gustave find out...)
The delayed gravity pulls Ferne sharply downward. Gordon has no time to save his collection; all he can do is watch as the Feline approaches rapidly.
The distance between them disappears, as do the complicated thoughts flashing through their minds. As they await the impending impact, there is only time for them to say a single word—

steps.name: Gordon & Ferne
steps.text: Shit...
